purpose: Distribution-channel decision for the G012 analytics-only release (orx-analytics 0.4.3 internal preview), fixed BEFORE any G012 build. The channel, its basis and its requirements live here; build_app.sh validates this file (validate-decision) before building and refuses mismatches, and scripts/joint_release.py (goal g012) binds it by sha256 at build/candidate time. G012 re-uses the G011 channel split verbatim: internal preview ships the honestly-labeled ad-hoc dev-flavor zip; official stays blocked on the two credential gaps re-probed live below. ORX is NOT re-published by G012 (its product input is the published v0.4.0 tag), so this decision governs the Analytics app archive and Python distribution artifacts only. Channel outcomes are recorded into this file's results slots by the G012 build phase; a channel switch requires an explicit new decision entry.
downgrade_policy: official failure (missing credentials, failed signing/notarization/staple/assessment) exits non-zero with a machine-readable JSON reason and produces no archive; it never becomes an internal-preview artifact. Channel outcomes are recorded in separate results slots; a channel switch requires an explicit new decision entry in this file.
